notes.title: Meet new Movavi Video Editor 2024: It Gets Even Better
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576030/Movavi_Video_Editor_2024/][b]Meet the new Video Editor 2024![/b]
[/url]
[b]Here are just some of the fresh features:[/b]

[b]- Revamped timeline. [/b]
The new timeline is now clearer and more streamlined. Get your projects done faster and have more fun with any types of videos.

[b]- Frame-precise cuts in a click. [/b]
Give your videos a sharper look with the new video-cutting tool. Easily make precise cuts and create eye-catching montages.

[b]- Perfect-match overlay effects. [/b]
Now each overlay effect has 13 blending modes to choose from. Try each of them  and pick the one that fits your video perfectly.

[b]- Pro-quality color correction. 
[/b]Get next-level color correction with the same simplicity. Boost colors in a snap and make more viewers fall in love with your videos.
[b]
- Our best effects – at your fingertips. [/b]
Create awesome videos in any style with our huge collection of professionally designed effects. 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36720/Upgrade_Movavi_Video_EDitor_2022_to_Movavi_Video_Editor_2024/]Get the new 2024 version of Movavi Video Editor with an upgrade discount.
[/url][/b]

notes.title: The awesome update for Movavi Video Editor Plus is out now!
notes.content:
[b]Movavi Video Editor Plus 22.2 is all about creating a unique atmosphere in your videos. Here are the new features that will help you achieve that unique vibe:[/b]

[list]
[*]  A pack of trendy animated overlay effects that will boost your visual in a click: enjoy Glitch, Frame, Lasers, Noise, Waves, and other overlays.

[img]https://new-img.movavi.com/products/0013/37/78b03c73f817147c8d279fbdbaae11ecb8da9bf4.gif[/img]

[*]  A reverberation audio effect for creating a relaxed or mysterious sound for your videos.
[*]  In addition to the built-in LUTs, you can now upload your custom LUTs to get the desired look for your videos.
[/list]

notes.title: The next update to Movavi Video Editor Plus will blow your mind!
notes.content:
[h3]The new features in Movavi Video Editor Plus will enable you to create a unique atmosphere in your videos:[/h3]

[list]
[*] A pack of on-trend animated overlay effects will take your visual to the next level: enjoy Glitch, Frame, Lasers, Noise, Waves, and other overlays.
[*] A reverberation audio effect will create a relaxed or mysterious atmosphere in your videos.
[*] In addition to the built-in LUTs, you’ll be able to upload your own custom LUTs to get the look you want in your videos. 
[/list]

notes.title: Fantastic news!
notes.content:
[b]Here are just some of the enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Compressor and Gate[/b] audio enhancement tools to reduce the difference between loud and soft noise and set the decibel level. Click just one button to get higher quality sound. And now you can save clips in which the sound is low
[*] [b]New audio effects for sound distortion[/b] – apply them to voice and music as filters. Just drag and drop on the timeline and set the intensity level
[*][b] Sound visualization[/b]. No more complaints about volume jumps in your videos. No more damage to your headphones and eardrums. Now you can see the volume levels during the montage and smooth out everything!
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1783530/extras/Pic_1_ru,_en_%D0%9D%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%8B%D0%B5_%D0%B0%D1%83%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BE%D1%8D%D1%84%D1%84%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%82%D1%8B__%D0%A7%D1%82%D0%BE_%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%BE___1_.png?t=1635417298[/img]

You can also [b]apply these effects sets:[/b] [i][b]Handy Set, Let's Start a Vlog Set, Creative Set, and Horror Stories Set.[/b] [/i]
Draw attention to your clips with zinging neon titles, create vlogs with social media stickers, add catchy intros to your tutorials, and prepare spooky clips based on your favorite horror stories! But that’s not all –in this release, you can find other effects sets, too.

If you already [b]have effects packs for Movavi Video Editor 20 and 21[/b], you can [b]get additional sets for the new 22 version for free — they will be available in your Steam Library.[/b] These are: [i][b]Cinematic set, Technology set, Magic world, VHS, Future is now, and Christmas Party Set.[/b][/i]
